channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan expected to push for debate on nuclear subs in security document revisions
item.description: Japan is expected to say in the documents due by the year-end that it will "begin considering and reach a conclusion" on the controversial issue.

item.title: The Indian 'Tamasha queen' whose fans paid for a show that never happened
item.description: A new Bollywood flim spotlights the remarkable life of dancer and singer Vithabhai Narayangaonkar.

item.title: Two bodies found on Miyagi mountainside in hunt for missing Yokohama girl
item.description: One of the bodies may be of a girl from Yokohama who has been reported missing, according to investigative sources.

item.title: LDP proposes ¥10 million benefits for third and subsequent children
item.description: The financial support measure is part of a population strategy the government plans to formulate by year-end.

item.title: CPTPP members agree to set up support office in Japan
item.description: The office will be in charge of arranging meeting schedules and managing documents for members of the multilateral free trade pact.

item.title: Sheikh Hasina's planned return puts Bangladesh on edge - and India in a bind
item.description: The ousted prime minister's December homecoming plan deepens Dhaka-Delhi tensions and risks fresh unrest.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
